macleod_gloom_horizon.mp3.title: Gloom Horizon
macleod_gloom_horizon.mp3.description: Mournful piece with a nice melody. Melody starts at 40 seconds in. Feel free to chop out as much opening as is required. The low beat is a bass drum with the attacks cut off.

macleod_gagool.mp3.title: Gagool
macleod_gagool.mp3.description: A very nice piece with repeated themes... not sure what one should expect, given the instrumentation of this piece - but it probably won't disappoint.

macleod_ignosi.mp3.title: Ignosi
macleod_ignosi.mp3.instruments: Trombones, Basses, Flutes, Clarinet, Marimba, Percussion, Horn, Violins, Violas
macleod_ignosi.mp3.description: Starts without percussion, then adds in a groove later on.

macleod_mary_celeste.mp3.title: Mary Celeste
macleod_mary_celeste.mp3.instruments: Tuba, Bass Clarinet, French Horns, Contrabassoon, Bass Flute, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboe, Marimba, Tubular Bells, Cellos, Violins, Violas
macleod_mary_celeste.mp3.description: Dark and broody, this one starts thin, gets really muddy, and then releases to a faster clearer section. Where would I use this? No idea. I'm sure you'll think of something, though!

macleod_oppressive_gloom.mp3.title: Oppressive Gloom
macleod_oppressive_gloom.mp3.feel: Dark, Eerie, Epic, Mysterious, Somber, Suspenseful
macleod_oppressive_gloom.mp3.description: Moody moody dark score. Almost a death march. Loops pretty darned well - but you need to trim the end.

macleod_satiate_only_strings.mp3.title: Satiate - only strings
macleod_satiate_only_strings.mp3.description: I piece unlike anything I've done, this is a very difficult piece to process emotionally. It just never lets the audience rest. There are a lot of uses for this sort of piece.  It is also available with percussion, which gives it a more immediacy.

macleod_texture_for_violincello_and_pian.title: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2
macleod_texture_for_violincello_and_pian.description: An interesting jumble of cello and some piano fused together to create an eerie and intense piece the likes of which no one has ever heard of...until now.

macleod_dark_times.mp3.title: Dark Times
macleod_dark_times.mp3.description: Deeply troubling and somber, this piece is heavy on the bass strings, especially in the last minute. The feel is very dark and funereal, and could be used to depict the beginning of the apocalypse.

macleod_end_of_the_era.mp3.title: End of the Era
macleod_end_of_the_era.mp3.description: Alto Flute along with the low brass in the beginning, switching to strings. Final sounds are more harsh than the beginning. Ends with a tiny flourish.

macleod_drums_of_the_deep.mp3.title: Drums of the Deep
macleod_drums_of_the_deep.mp3.description: Moody and atmospheric with a hint of power.

macleod_serpentine_trek.mp3.title: Serpentine Trek
macleod_serpentine_trek.mp3.instruments: Flute, Clarinet, Bass Clarinet, Alto Flute, Violin, Percussion
